screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's ask if we really need it.

screens.title: Need it, or want it now?

cards.caption: A need keeps you safe and healthy.
A want is a fun extra. That's okay too.

screens.penny: Wants are fine, {name}. We just choose on purpose.

screens.prompt: Your shoes have holes and your feet get wet. Are new shoes a need?
screens.pennyHint: Think about staying dry and safe, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Dry feet keep you healthy, so that's a need.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Wet feet can make you poorly. So new shoes are a need.
screens.retryIntro: Let's look at the shoes again, {name}.

screens.prompt: You have two teddies at home. Is a third one a need?
screens.rightMessage: That's it, {name}! A third teddy is a fun extra, not a need.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! You already have teddies, so this one is a want.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about the teddies again, {name}.

screens.story: Kim has 6 coins. Her school bag is torn. She also likes a new game.

options.label: Mend the school bag
options.outcome: Kim fixes her bag. Her books stay dry. She still has coins for the game later.

options.label: Buy the game today
options.outcome: Kim plays the game. Her books fall out of the torn bag on the way.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Needs come first, then the fun extras.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The game is fun. But the torn bag is what she needs.

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: Needs first. Wants are still okay after.
